messages:
maya: Quick check — planning a staged cutover for model v3.2-int4 to 10% traffic in staging tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Smoke eval ok but a small long-doc rerank dip showed up on the analytics slice. Propose automatic fallback if long-doc MRR drops >= 1.2% or overall RMSE increases > 0.8% for 5m.
liam: Can you paste the smoke numbers? how many samples for the long-doc slice?
sophia: long-doc slice was ~3.2k queries, weighted by doc length. A/B looked like +0.6% on shortdoc MRR, -1.4% longdoc MRR, overall -0.1% weighted. p95 latency +9ms.
maya: here's the quick diff from the eval run:```
shortdoc_mrr: +0.006
longdoc_mrr: -0.014
overall_mrr: -0.001
p95_latency_ms: +9
error_rate: 0.2% (same)
```
jun: thanks. my vote: allow 10% probation for 30m, expand to 50% if no regression >0.7% on the long-doc slice and latency p95 delta <15ms. fallback immediate to v3.1 if thresholds exceeded.
liam: agree. add KV warmup check — int4 cold starts showed inconsistent beam scoring in the last run. If rerank variance (stdev of score delta) > 0.015 on the slice, trigger soft rollback.
maya: good call. adding metrics: longdoc_mrr_delta, rerank_sd, p95_latency_delta. fallback policy priority: 1) automatic rollback, 2) route to float16 variant, 3) alert @oncall.
ops-bot: reminder — deploy window note created: https://internal.redwood/prod-rollouts/1755556789 (auto). Will run smoke traffic replay before cutover.
sophia: one more: include sanity samples (10 seed prompts) that exercise chain-of-thought and multi-doc concat. If any of those fail structured-output checks, abort immediately.
zach: how about thresholds for small but persistent drift? we saw a -0.6% sustained longdoc drop last week that never crossed immediate rollback but was bad for 12h. maybe add 3h rolling average >=0.8% then manual hold.
maya: yes — add a cooldown: if a 3h rolling average breach occurs, open a hold ticket and pause automated expansion.
liam: make sure logs include model binary checksum + quantization metadata for repro. something like:```
model: v3.2-int4
cksum: sha256:abcd...1234
quant: nf4, symmetric, group_size=64
kv_cache_warmup: true
```
maya: plan summary: 10% traffic @09:30 UTC, probation 30m, metrics to watch: longdoc_mrr_delta (auto rollback >=1.2% over 5m), rerank_sd (soft rollback >=0.015), p95_latency_delta (rollback >=20ms), 3h roll avg alert >=0.8% -> manual hold. ops-bot run smoke replay and seed checks. any objections?
sophia: no objections from me. :+1:
jun: sounds good. i'll own the rollback runbook and post links to playbook after the cutover.
maya: thanks team. I'll schedule and post the exact traffic config in the rollout ticket.
